style_en: 日本のアニメ調、くっきりした主線、落ち着いた色、明るく均一な光、古墳時代の日本（みずら・衣褌・勾玉）。全話で同じ絵柄。背景は必ず真っ白
avoid_en: 文字、ロゴ、現代の建物や服、大陸風（中国風）の服、裸、血

izanagi.desc_en: Izanagi, a dignified young male god of ancient Japan in his mid-20s, black hair tied in mizura loops beside both ears, clean-shaven, white Kofun-period kinu tunic with a dark blue sash and white hakama trousers tied below the knees with red cords, a green magatama bead necklace, a straight sword at the waist

izanami.desc_en: Izanami, a gentle young goddess of ancient Japan in her early 20s, long black hair with the top tied in a loop, white Kofun-period kinu tunic over a long pale vermilion mo skirt, a sheer pale scarf over the shoulders, a green magatama bead necklace, soft kind eyes

amaterasu.desc_en: Amaterasu, the sun goddess, a serene young woman with very long straight black hair and a thin golden circlet, white and gold Kofun-period robe with a long white mo skirt, a magatama bead necklace, a soft golden glow around her

hiruko_god.desc_en: Hiruko as a god, a slender young man about 18 years old with a calm, slightly lonely face, black hair in mizura loops, pale sea-blue and white Kofun-period tunic and trousers, a string of white shells as a necklace, a faint sea-blue glow, barefoot

ebisu.desc_en: Ebisu, the god of fortune, a plump cheerful elderly man with a round smiling face and narrow laughing eyes, a tall black eboshi hat, a kariginu hunting robe in muted gold and green, holding a bamboo fishing rod in his right hand and a large red sea bream under his left arm

fisher.desc_en: a humble fisherman of old Japan, middle-aged, tanned skin, a cloth headband, a simple patched indigo short kimono tied with a rope belt, bare legs and straw sandals
